first.text:
It's just the label for the next version of your program. Your program is kept as a numbered history: every time something changes, a new version is recorded so what you trained under at any point can be looked up later. The one you're on now is the third since you moved onto this system on 1 Nov; adding the incline curl creates the fourth. Nothing else about it matters to you, and I shouldn't have put the label in front of you.

So in plain terms: say yes and your program becomes "the same week, with incline curls as the last thing on Monday". Want me to go ahead?
